title: FBI briefing to Congress and ongoing FBI investigation of legacy program
summary: Ross Coulthart tells of FBI briefing to Congress and ongoing FBI investigation of legacy program, about 2025 at Washington, D.C., and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Cuz I'm told that the briefing that the FBI gave in Congress really blew people away. And watch that FBI ongoing investigation. I've dealt with some of the people on the investigation team.

plain: Ross Coulthart, a journalist who reports on UFOs, says on Jesse Michels' podcast that he was told a 2025 briefing the FBI, the US federal police, gave to members of Congress in Washington really blew people away. He urges people to watch an ongoing FBI investigation into a long-running secret UFO program, and says he has dealt with some of the investigators. If true, it would mean federal police are now looking into the program itself.
